title: Reckoning the Allowance Made Available as a Healthy Options Card Comes Into Use
content:
This is the basis on which the allowance made available on a Ridgecrest Healthy Options Card as the card is brought into use is reckoned.

**The amount.** The allowance made available is the share of that period's allowance the card is owed, rounded to the nearest cent at the end and at no earlier step.

**Where it is placed.** It is placed in the benefit period the programme opened in, that being the period whose allowance it is.

**The quantities it is built from.**

| Quantity | Its value |
|---|---|
| the months in a benefit period | a benefit period is taken to have 1 month |
| the months of the opening period the allowance covers | the whole of a benefit period |
| the allowance a benefit period carries | the card's own tier quarterly allowance |
| the share of that period's allowance the card is owed | the whole of that period's allowance |

**Worked through on hypothetical figures.** Take a card whose tier carries a quarterly allowance of 175.00 USD. The allowance a benefit period carries is 175.00 USD. The months of the opening period the allowance covers are the whole of a benefit period, and a benefit period is taken to have 1 month. The share of that period's allowance the card is owed is the whole of that period's allowance, 175.00 USD. The allowance made available is therefore 175.00 USD, rounded to the nearest cent once at the end, and it is placed in the benefit period the programme opened in. On a card whose tier carries a quarterly allowance of 45.00 USD the same reckoning gives 45.00 USD.
